animate.description: Whether components animate to the state of a slide (e.g. the map flies to the new view).

appStateId.description: Id of the `<app-state>` the slides are applied to. Not needed when the story is inside it.

collapsible.description: Whether the card can be collapsed.

id.description:
Id of the component, target of the `Story.Next`, `Story.Previous`, `Story.GoTo` and
`Story.Reset` events.

keyboard.description:
Keyboard navigation (arrows, Page Up/Down, Home, End):
`global` anywhere on the page, `focus` when the card has the focus, `none`.

layout.description: `floating` shows the story as a card over the page; `inline` in the page flow.

repository.description: Repository where the story is stored.

showProgress.description: Whether the slide position (e.g. 2 / 5) is shown.

showTitle.description: Whether the story title is shown.

startSlide.description: Slide shown first, from 1. A slide given in the URL (`storySlide`) takes precedence.

story.description: IRI of the story to play.

transitionDuration.description: Duration of the animation in milliseconds.

width.description: Width of the card, as a CSS length.
